POST keeps the same generic 502 when the failed-state recovery write also fails; the exact regression test remains on master.
POST catches checkout-session metadata persistence failure and returns no checkout payload; later master compensation logic is stricter.
POST fails with a generic 502 before creating a provider session; the exact regression test remains on master.
LivePlayback now sends internal products only to the same-origin buyer-details route and validates explicit merchant URLs before external navigation.
useCheckoutNavigationLock and disabled/aria-busy purchase controls keep all purchase actions locked until navigation settles or times out.
Checkout stores a server-verified affiliateClickId and processPaymentWebhook updates only the matching click after a paid event, excluding retries, failures, refunds, and mismatches.
LivePlayback reports navigation/identity failures, while CommerceCheckoutForm owns payment API pending and generic error feedback after the flow moved to the buyer-details page.
affiliateAttributionFromRequest ignores request referralCode and accepts only a signed same-visitor, same-vendor, active server-resolved click under the current live policy.
POST marks the reserved transaction failed with checkout_metadata_failed and still returns the generic 502 if compensation itself fails; both paths are tested.
checkoutResponse preserves Cache-Control: no-store on successful payloads; the exact regression test remains on master.
